tasks.name: Design UI for Todo List
tasks.description: Create wireframes and design the user interface for the Todo List application.

tasks.name: Implement Add Task Feature
tasks.description: Develop functionality to add new tasks to the Todo List.

tasks.name: Implement Delete Task Feature
tasks.description: Develop functionality to delete tasks from the Todo List.

tasks.name: Implement Complete Task Feature
tasks.description: Develop functionality to mark tasks as complete in the Todo List.

tasks.name: Create Database Schema
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema to store tasks.

tasks.name: Integrate Frontend with Backend
tasks.description: Connect the frontend UI with backend services to enable task management.

tasks.name: Test Add Task Feature
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the Add Task feature works correctly.

tasks.name: Test Delete Task Feature
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the Delete Task feature works correctly.

tasks.name: Test Complete Task Feature
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the Complete Task feature works correctly.

T1.implementation_approach: Use a design tool like Figma or Adobe XD to create wireframes and mockups for the Todo List UI. Focus on user-friendly design and intuitive layout.
T1.notes: Ensure the design is responsive and accessible.

T2.implementation_approach: Implement a function to add tasks to the list. Use a form to capture task details and update the state or database.
T2.notes: Consider validation for task input fields.

T3.implementation_approach: Implement a function to remove tasks from the list. Use task ID to identify and delete the task from the state or database.
T3.notes: Ensure the UI updates immediately after deletion.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a function to mark tasks as complete. Toggle task status and update the state or database.
T4.notes: Consider visual indicators for completed tasks.

T5.implementation_approach: Design a schema with tables for tasks, including fields for task ID, description, status, and timestamps.
T5.notes: Ensure normalization and consider indexing for performance.

T6.implementation_approach: Use RESTful API endpoints to connect frontend with backend. Implement AJAX calls to fetch and update data.

T7.implementation_approach: Write unit tests to verify the Add Task feature works correctly. Use mock data and test edge cases.
T7.notes: Focus on both functional and UI tests.

T8.implementation_approach: Write unit tests to verify the Delete Task feature works correctly. Ensure tasks are removed from the list and database.
T8.notes: Test for correct handling of non-existent task IDs.

T9.implementation_approach: Write unit tests to verify the Complete Task feature works correctly. Check that task status updates and UI reflects changes.
T9.notes: Include tests for toggling task status back to incomplete.
